rules.statement: A sale by a party to a partition action after interlocutory decree and before final decree of all the advantages or disadvantages, such as costs, &c, and also the share which he would be entitled to either in common or partition, is valid and not obnoxious to section 17 of the Partition Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "A sale by a party to a partition action after interlocutory decree and before final decree 'of all the advantages or disadvantages, such as costs, &c, and also the share which he would be entitled to either in common or partition,' by virtue of the decree in the partition action, was held to be valid, and not obnoxious to section 17 of the Partition Ordinance."
